about: Short things people say to a voice companion: the 'prompts' clip set (voicebench clips synth/record) and the pipeline benchmark's turns. Each is answered by the Thinking model, so they ask for a reply.
prompts: What's a good way to wind down after a really long day?
Can you remind me how many ounces are in a cup?
I just got the job! I can't believe it actually happened.
Ugh, my code broke again and I have no idea why.
Tell me something interesting about octopuses.
What should I make for dinner if I only have eggs, rice and some spinach?
Do you think it's going to be a good weekend for a hike?
Okay, give me one quick tip for sleeping better.
I'm kind of nervous about my presentation tomorrow morning.
Remind me, what's the difference between a latte and a cappuccino?
Sing me a tiny made up song about my cat, Biscuit.
How long should I boil an egg if I want the yolk a little runny?
Honestly, I'm just bored. Entertain me for a second.
What year did the first person walk on the moon?
Thanks, that was actually really helpful.

tts.text: I think that sounds like a great plan, and honestly you deserve a break.
[sigh] Fine, I'll help you, but you owe me one.
[laugh] Okay, that is actually hilarious. Tell me more!
If you only have eggs, rice and spinach, make a quick fried rice: wilt the spinach, push it aside, scramble two eggs in the same pan, then toss everything with the rice and a splash of soy sauce.
